author: DonaldMyTrump
body:
Hello avicus staff members. My name is YouCantCMe/Zac.
I was falsely punished for excessive spam/profanity. It was on a scrim server where the other teams were using profanities and spamming. Although I was not using profanities I was spamming and even if it happened on a regular server, not a scrim server where it was allowed the correct punishment would have been a verbal warn according to the punishment guidelines. https://avicus.net/forums/09e2758fd
